methodologyNotes: Roster of 12 high-search corded and cordless circular saw models from DeWalt, Milwaukee, Makita, Bosch, Skil/Skilsaw, Ryobi, Ridgid, and Festool. Specs re-verified against manufacturer product pages (dewalt.com, milwaukeetool.com, makitatools.com, festoolusa.com, skil.com) plus authorized dealers (toolnut.com, acmetools.com) and spec aggregators (Grainger, Travers, Zoro, powertools.techreviewer.com) and major retailers (Home Depot, Lowe's, Walmart). Power source is 'corded' or 'cordless'; voltage_or_amps carries rated amperage for corded tools and battery voltage for cordless tools; weight_lb is tool-only unless noted; brushless is a boolean. Prices are current US standard retail / MSRP (bare tool where applicable) and can fluctuate at large retailers. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: DeWalt DCS570B 20V MAX XR Brushless 7-1/4 in. Circular Saw
products.priceNote: Standard bare-tool dealer price; Home Depot currently lists ~$197, price fluctuates by retailer/promotion
products.provenance: Specs confirmed via DeWalt product page and Home Depot listing: 7-1/4 in blade, 20 V, 5200 RPM, 57 deg bevel (positive stops 45/22.5), brushless, 7.3 lb. Release year 2017 corroborated by Pro Tool Reviews (Aug 2017, available Fall 2017) and ToolGuyd teaser. Price ~$169 reflects common bare-tool dealer price; Home Depot currently shows ~$197 (prices fluctuate).

products.name: DeWalt DWE575SB 7-1/4 in. Lightweight Corded Circular Saw with Electric Brake
products.priceNote: Current standard retail price, tool with contractor bag
products.provenance: Blade 7-1/4 in, 15 A, 8.8 lb confirmed on DeWalt product page. RPM 5200 confirmed via Grainger, Travers and Zoro spec listings (5,200 no-load RPM). Bevel 57 deg per DeWalt product page and Amazon (some distributor sheets state 56 deg; primary manufacturer page used). Price $179 confirmed at Lowe's/retail. Corded brushed motor (brushless false). Source URL corrected to live DeWalt product page.
